QuestInfo.name: Luminous Reunion
QuestInfo.1: You left with Lania to meet Luminous and gossip about him, but the Lupins aren't making things any easier. You'd better get them out of the way.
QuestInfo.2: Just like Phantom, Luminous didn't know me at all. There's... really only one explanation for this.
QuestInfo.0: You came all the way to Ellinia to look for the person who saw Luminous. Although the lead is thin, you must take whatever you can get. You need to find Luminous quickly.

1.0: Luminous's anger... I saw it in his eyes. Phantom was the same. They could only act so harsh towards a stranger. It's true... They've forgotten about me.
1.1: Is this what the sacrifice was? Not my life, but my very existence? A fate worse than death, to be forgotten...
1.2: Ha, it all makes sense now. I understand why Freud told a story of five heroes. That's why little Athena didn't remember me at all.
